fable.w: This provision only rescinds previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting reading: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $899,000 are rescinded.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation provision that rescinds (cancels) a specific amount of funding. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $899,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: This provision only cancels previously appropriated funds. Nobody outside the federal government is consulted, and there is no comment period, hearing, advisory body or right to sue. Calling the rescission a 'decision' doesn't help, because Congress acts alone here with no outside participation.
opus.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $899,000 are rescinded.
opus.b: The section only cancels $899,000 of previously appropriated funds. Someone might think a "rescission" is a federal decision that outsiders could weigh in on, but the text sets up no comment period, hearing, consultation, advisory body or right to sue. It is purely a funding change made by Congress, and Congress is inside the federal government.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation rescission. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public comment periods, or requirements to consult with states, tribes, or the public mentioned in the text.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $899,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
